title: RBI Guidelines on Savings and Current Accounts
content: Under Reserve Bank of India (RBI) regulations, banks in India offer Basic Savings Bank Deposit Accounts (BSBDA) which do not require a minimum balance requirement. Regular savings accounts allow individuals to earn interest calculated on a daily product basis and credited quarterly or monthly. Current accounts are designed for businesses and entities, carrying no limit on transaction frequency but generally yielding zero interest. RBI mandates transparent disclosure of account maintenance fees and minimum average balance (MAB) requirements.
